description: Every field at its default: the reference's Init program, a 5.76 L crossplane V8, naturally aspirated. Its targets are a stock passenger-car V8's of that size at a standard day.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Warm idle
targets.source: a warm passenger-car V8 idles at 600 to 900 rpm in neutral (a rule of thumb)

targets.name: Manifold at idle
targets.source: a warm spark-ignition engine's manifold at idle is 25 to 50 kPa absolute (a rule of thumb: 15 to 22 inches of mercury of vacuum)

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a naturally aspirated spark-ignition engine's bmep at its torque peak is 1.0 to 1.4 MPa (Heywood, ch. 2): T = bmep Vd / 4 pi for 5.76 L

targets.name: Port gas at full load
targets.source: the gas at the exhaust valve at full load (exhaust.portTemperature): some 1100 to 1300 K for a spark-ignition engine before the port and pipe cool it (Heywood, ch. 14; the integrator measured 1100 to 1330 K across three engines)

targets.name: Header gas at full load
targets.source: a thermocouple a little way down a primary reads 900 to 1100 K at full load on a petrol engine (makers' exhaust-gas-temperature data): the gas after the port's and the header's cooling (tel.exhaust.headerTemperature, asked of card G)
